text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: p95 latency breach detected on runtime-prod (canary slice C) after deploy. Alert rule: runtime.p95.latency > 1.2s.

maria: Paging oncall — seeing kernel_fallback spikes and batcher error churn right after the rollout. Can we pause the rollout?

cheng: Investigating now. Stack shows a sudden increase in KernelFallback events + microbatch queue thrash. Probable regress in batcher scheduling/kernel selector.

maria: Logs: ```
W runtime/kernel_selector.go:213 - KernelFallback: selected soft-fallback path for model gptx-v1, reason=kernel_timeout
E runtime/batcher.go:487 - microbatch overflow: dropped=12 slice=canary-C
```

paul: Is the new_batcher_v2 flag on for canary? If so flip to false for canary only.

cheng: Confirmed flag=true for canary-C and canary-D. Flipping canary flag now.

paul: /featureflag set new_batcher_v2 canary=false -> done :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: starting rollback of release batcher-v2 (release/2026-03-17). Rolling back canary slice C -> D.

oncall-bot: Note: alert suppression active for this incident during rollback window.

cheng: After flag flip + rollback, p95 trending down. Early numbers: p95 1.45s -> 0.42s over 3 mins. KernelFallback rate back to baseline.

maria: Customer impact summary: brief spike in 500s and high tail latency for ~7 minutes. Rough uplift: 2-3% error rate on affected canary, no large-scale customer outage observed. CS notified.

nicholas: Thanks. Start a minimal incident doc with timeline and exec summary. We'll expand in postmortem.

maria: Timeline note: deploy started -> +2m kernel_fallback spike -> +4m alert -> flag flip + rollback initiated at +6m -> stable at +12m.

cheng: Root cause hypothesis for now: batcher v2 introduced a scheduling change that can select a kernel path with a timeout for some model sequences; causes fallback thrash under steady microburst traffic. Need deeper reproduction.

paul: Quick mitigation actions recorded: 1) flip feature flag for canary, 2) rollback release, 3) throttle rollout and hold.

maria: Escalation: no immediate customer SLAs broken, but contact list pinged for customers with high traffic. Ops to send brief to trust & safety + CS.

nicholas: Handing off monitoring to night oncall @sara — please keep watch for 1h and escalate if p95 > 800ms or KernelFallback rate > 2x baseline.

sara: Got it. Monitoring dashboards open, alert thresholds tightened locally. I'll post updates if anything regresses.

paul: Add test permutations to CI: sequence lengths that trigger kernel selector path + microbatch stress.

cheng: Agreed — creating repro job now and saving logs to /var/logs/incidents/7382104321 for postmortem.

maria: Thanks everyone. Creating incident ticket and marking this thread for postmortem. :clipboard:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: rollback complete; incident transitioned to monitoring. If stability holds for 60m, incident will be closed and PM/Eng notified for postmortem scheduling.

sara: Acknowledged, monitoring.

maria: Hand-off complete.
